title: A scene graph
description:
Build a tree of game objects where children move with their parents.

```
ship at (100, 50), rotation 0
  turret at (10, 0) relative -> world (110, 50)
    barrel at (5, 0) relative -> world (115, 50)
rotate ship 90 degrees -> barrel world (100, 65)
```
hints: World position: start from the parent's world position and add your local offset rotated by the parent's world angle (lesson 3.02).
Rotating `(x, y)` by `a`: `(x cos a - y sin a, x sin a + y cos a)`.
requirements: Nodes own their children (`std::vector<std::unique_ptr<Node>>`) and hold a local position and rotation.
Removing a node removes its whole subtree.
stretch: Cache world transforms and recompute only when a parent moved (a dirty flag).
